data.title: LG Energy Solution to supply 46,100 round cells to Mercedes
data.description: According to a media report, LG Energy Solution will supply round cells with a diameter of 46 millimeters and a height of 100 millimeters - a novel format - for Mercedes-Benz's next-gen EVs. Deliveries are set to begin in 2028.

data.title: South Korea: Water to open 23 fast-charging sites with 400 kW chargers
data.description: Water, the EV charging brand of South Korean renewable energy company Brite Energy Partners, has announced plans to open 23 new fast-charging sites along highways across the country. It has already opened the first site ahead of the scheduled October start.

data.title: Q3 figures: Tesla factories regains production footing
data.description: Tesla has regained its footing in production and delivery. After a mixed year in 2025, the first three quarters of 2026 have demonstrated a newly found consistency - evident in 464,000 vehicles produced and just over 486,000 delivered in the third quarter.

data.title: Pos Malaysia transitions to EVs for a third of its parcel deliveries
data.description: Malaysia's national postal and parcel service provider, Pos Malaysia, has announced it now delivers one in three parcels using EVs. The company has deployed electric vehicles for delivery operations across the country, including Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah and Sarawak.

data.title: FlixBus launches long-distance electric bus route between Vienna and Bratislava
data.description: Starting October 1, FlixBus will deploy eight electric coaches in regular scheduled service between Vienna and Bratislava. The approx. 80 km route will offer 66 daily trips.

data.title: RWTH Aachen develops scalable manufacturing for multi-layer electrodes
data.description: Under the ProMeBa research project, RWTH Aachen is developing scalable processes for multilayer battery electrodes. The goal is to transfer the technology from the lab to pilot scale.

data.title: UK posts strongest-ever month for BEV registrations in September
data.description: Last month, Battery-electric vehicle sales reached record monthly volumes in the UK, with registrations rising by 36.3 per cent year-on-year to 99,199 units. According to preliminary figures from SMMT, the overall market share of BEVs also climbed to 28.3 per cent.

data.title: India: Kolkata Police to induct 183 electric motorcycles
data.description: The police department of Kolkata, the capital of the eastern Indian state West Bengal, has announced plans to add 183 electric motorcycles to its fleet. It has taken delivery of the first 60 units, and once it procures the remaining 123 units, the rollout will represent one of the largest electric motorcycle deployments by any police force in the country.

data.title: Green SM expands electric taxi and rental services in Indonesia
data.description: VinFast subsidiary, Green SM, has launched an initial fleet of 500 6-seater VinFast Green Limo electric cars for its ride-sharing, taxi and rental services in Indonesia. The Vietnamese automotive giant's ride-sharing subsidiary has also launched VinFast electric motorbikes as part of its service in the Southeast Asian country's capital and its largest city, Jakarta.

data.title: Teslas can now drive off with a charging cable connected
data.description: Tesla has introduced a new feature for its electric vehicles called 'Emergency Drive Away', which allows drivers to move away even with the charging cable plugged in. This is designed to enable people to quickly escape life-threatening emergencies at charging stations.

data.title: LA Metro orders 200 electric buses from ENC
data.description: The LA Metro has awarded ENC a contract to supply 220 40-foot AXESS EVO-BE battery electric buses. The order is the largest made for 40-foot battery electric buses by a US transit agency.

data.title: Polestar launches new fast-charging tariffs
data.description: Polestar is expanding its public charging offering in Europe with two new subscription tiers. With 'Plus' and 'Pro', customers receive discounts at selected fast-charging networks for a monthly fee.

data.title: BMW begins Gen6 battery production in Irlbach-Straßkirchen
data.description: BMW has officially opened its new battery plant in Irlbach-Straßkirchen and launched series production. The site will supply sixth-generation high-voltage batteries initially for the new BMW i3 from Munich and is set to play a central role in Germany's production network in the future.

data.title: Orders for the 2027 BMW i3 open early in US
data.description: Since Wednesday, customers have been able to place orders for the 2027 BMW i3 - a week earlier than planned. The electric saloon is initially being offered in a single all-wheel-drive configuration, with an estimated EPA range of up to 468 miles (753 km).

data.title: September was BYD’s strongest month of the year so far
data.description: With a total of 463,561 'NEVs' delivered, Chinese manufacturer BYD recorded its strongest month of 2026 so far. The number of all-electric vehicles increased significantly, while plug-in hybrids declined. Once again, exports to Europe and other markets played a key role.

data.title: Joya: new Swiss CPO replaces four charging provider brands
data.description: The newly formed Swiss charging provider Joya is now bundling the charging offerings of Energie 360° Mobilität, Gofast, Swisscharge, and Move Mobility. With more than 7,500 public charging points, including over 1,800 fast-charging points, Joya is now the largest CPO in Switzerland from the outset.

data.title: Nova Scotia introduces new levy on EVs and plug-in hybrids
data.description: The Canadian province has introduced a new levy on EVs and plug-in hybrids, with owners set to face additional charges of CA$500 and CA$250 respectively every two years. The levy takes effect on October 1 and will apply when vehicle permits are issued or renewed.

data.title: MG IM6 first drive: 553 kW and air suspension for €62,990
data.description: The MG IM6 is a nearly five-meter-long electric SUV with 800-volt technology, all-wheel steering, and a power output of up to 553 kW (751 hp). The Chinese company is launching the premium car with a starting price is 56,990 euros, while the all-wheel-drive version is available for 60,990 euros. The all-wheel-drive model also offers an optional adaptive air suspension, which noticeably changes the car's character. During the first test drive in the French Jura, the real cost  becomes clear.

data.title: Ampol to acquire Evie Networks in AU$225m deal
data.description: Australian fuel retailer Ampol is to acquire the charge point operator Evie Networks for AU$225 million (~€135 m). The deal is set to add over 1,030 charging bays to Ampol's existing network, meaning it will feature around 1,425 bays across over 400 sites.

data.title: Student VENTRA EV project aims to capture tyre and brake wear particles
data.description: Students at TU Eindhoven have developed an electric car concept called VENTRA, which is designed to capture fine dust from tire and brake wear while driving. Additionally, the vehicle focuses on lightweight construction and provides guidance for a low-wear driving style.
